text: Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules associated with document CHEMBL1138844. Source data from molecule_dictionary, compound_records, and compound_structures. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, and compound_records to docs on doc_id. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1138844' and compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL. Sort rows by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles in ascending order.
